game_start.intro: Papadi e qala. Pampiri e kgethilweng: {trump_suit} (karete e kgethilweng: {trump_str}).

player_prompt.intro:
U ena le Player {player_id} ho German Whist.
{phase_info}
U na le {hand_size} karete.
Bapala karete ka '[play N]', moo N e leng sebaka sa yona setšong sa hao (ka mohlala '[play 3]').
player_prompt.phase_learning: MOHATO OA HO ITHUTA: ea hlōlang mohato o mong le o mong oa papali e nka karete e shebileng holimo 'me ea lahlehileng a hula karete ea ho qetela mokatong. Lits'oants'o tse fumanoeng mothating ona ha li baloe bakeng sa tlhōlo.
player_prompt.phase_playing: MOHATO OA HO BALA: mokatong o felile. Leqheka le leng le le leng ho tloha joale ho ea pele lea bohlokoa bakeng sa tlhōlo.

next_card.playing_phase: Ha ho na karete e fanoang - karolo ea papali e qalile.
next_card.deck_empty: Mokotla ha o na letho - ha ho karete e fanoang.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebelisa '[play N]' ho bapala karete ea Nth letsohong la hao.
invalid_move.bad_position: Sebaka seo sa karete ha se eo. U tšoere likarete tsa {hand_size} .
invalid_move.must_follow_suit: U tlameha ho latela mohlala oa hae 'me u bapale karete ea {lead_suit}.
invalid_move.invalid_play: Karete eo e ke ke ea bapaloa.

trick.won_learning: Player {winner_id} a kenya trick le {card} a tsamaea le karte e emeng

phase.learning_complete: Mokotla o felile. Boemo ba ho ithuta bo fetile - leqheka ka leng le setseng ke la bohlokoa bakeng sa tlhōlo.

draw.loser_received: U ile ua lahleheloa ke papali 'me u hula {card} ho tloha mokatong.
draw.winner_preview: Karete e latelang eo ho fanoang ka eona ke {card}.

turn.scores_learning: Matshwao ao a thwengwa - Tshwantshwane 0: {tricks0}, Tshwantshwane 1: {tricks1}

hand.no_cards_in_hand: Ha ho na likarete tse ka letsohong la hao.

trick_view.empty: Ha ho likarete tse bapalang thetso ena.
